author: Filmento
description:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues Peter Parke's journey by bringing in The Punisher and Jean Grey. And it's the third successful movie of all time, half a billion dollars ahead of even No Way Home which had Tobey and Andrew. How the hell? In this video, let's try to find the answer.
